senses.gloss:
अह्वला अ-ह्वला, f., Ved. not fluctuating,
not stumbling, firmness; the plant Semecarpus Ana-
cardium.

आह्वृ आ-ह्वृ, cl. 1. P., Ved. -ह्वरति, -ह्वर्-
तुम्, to make crooked, to injure.
आ-ह्वर, अस्, m., N. of a fortress of the Uśīnaras.

आ-ह्वरक, अस्, m. a low or expelled man who,
after having offered a sacrifice to the manes, takes
the sacrificial food for himself.

आह्वारक, आस्, m. pl. the Āhvārakas, a recension
of the black Yajur-veda (distinct from the Taittirīya)
named from Ahvāra or Āhvāra.
आ-ह्वृति, इस्, m., N. of a prince.

आह्वे आ-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. or poet. A. -ह्वयति,
-ते, -ह्वातुम्, to call near; to summon; to invite,
ask; A. to provoke, challenge, emulate: Caus.
-ह्वाययति, -यितुम्, to send for; to cause to invite
or summon or challenge; provoked: Desid. -जुहू-
षति, to wish to call near or invite: Intens. -जोहवीति,
to call.

आ-ह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what calls, a crier;
named, called; (आ), f. a name, appellation.

आ-ह्वय, अस्, m. a lawsuit arising from a dispute
about games with animals, as cock-fighting &c.; ap-
pellation, name (generally as last member of a com-
pound, the first member of which, though commonly
an appellative noun, is used as a proper name).
आ-ह्वाय, अस्, m. a summons, a name.
आ-ह्वयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, calling, challenging.

आ-ह्वयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be summoned or
invited.

आ-ह्वान, अम्, n. calling, invitation, a call or sum-
mons; invocation of a deity; challenge; legal sum-
mons; an appellation, a name; designation of a
liturgical formula.
—आह्वान-दर्शन, अम्, n. day
of trial.

आह्वानय, nom. P. आह्वानयति, -यितुम्, (in law)
to summon.
आ-ह्वायक, अस्, m. a messenger, a courier.

आ-ह्वाययितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be called before
a tribunal.
